scripts.verify: vp check && pnpm env:check && pnpm check:deps && pnpm check:suppressions && pnpm check:doc-pins && pnpm check:knip && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm check:rust && pnpm check:firmware && pnpm check:hardware && pnpm build
scripts.check:hardware: cargo run -q -p drone-cli -- validate && cargo run -q -p drone-cli -- codegen --check
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace
scripts.check:firmware: cd firmware/target-stm32h7 && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --release -- -D warnings && cargo build --release
